Name: Mod Update Menu
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: Adds an in game menu to the title screen letting you know if you need to update your mods or SMAPI! Provides handy links to the download locations!
Description:
See unofficial update for the latest SDV version here: https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-160#post-123104Mod Update Menu

This mod adds a menu to the title screen which shows the update status of all your mods and SMAPI. It also provides a link to update the mod/SMAPI if it is out of date.

How to use:

*   Press the new button that appears in the main menu on the left to open the menu.

*   Press the column names to sort by that column (it cycles through ascending and then descending).

*   Hover over each entry in the menu to see more info (author name, why it is outdated, full url).

*   Click on the Link entry (i.e. NexusMods) to have your browser open up the download page.

*   Use the scroll wheel to scroll up and down through all your mods.
The left indicator on the button is for SMAPI (green checkmark = SMAPI is up to date, yellow exclamation mark = SMAPI is outdated), and the right one if for your mods (same scheme as for SMAPI).
Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI 3.6.
